scope: Local standalone accessibility check; no provider or external requests.

healthy.ariaSnapshot:
- main:
  - region "Gameplay area"
  - link "◉ orbsie":
    - /url: https://orbsie.com
  - text: A pocketful of sunshine
  - button "↻ Restart"
  - text: "Score: 0 W A S D / Arrow keys to move · Space to jump"

unavailable.ariaSnapshot:
- main:
  - region "Gameplay area"
  - link "◉ orbsie":
    - /url: https://orbsie.com
  - text: A pocketful of sunshine
  - button "↻ Restart"
  - status:
    - region "Graphics are unavailable":
      - heading "Graphics are unavailable" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Neither WebGL2 nor the software canvas renderer could initialize in this browser.
      - paragraph: This browser could not start its 2D graphics fallback. Your world needs a browser with canvas support.
      - list:
        - listitem: In Chrome, open Settings → System.
        - listitem: Find “Use graphics acceleration when available”, then choose Relaunch.
      - paragraph: This exported world stays loaded while you use Check again.
      - button "Check again"
  - text: W A S D / Arrow keys to move · Space to jump
